notes.title: Devlog May 2025 – Where are we at the moment
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It’s been a while, almost a year since the last update here, so I wanted to take a moment to share where things are at and what’s been going on behind the scenes with Serial Victims.

Over the past year, I’ve actually rebuilt the game from scratch. That might sound a bit drastic, but it’s been the right move. A lot of the original features are still here, but things are way more stable, cleaner, and overall more solid to build on now. 

[b]What’s New[/b]

Basically, everything, I will be posting new screenshots of the game in the upcoming weeks getting into some reworked and new features. 

Lately, I’ve been mainly working on the main game menu, along with proper settings and keybinds. I know it’s not the flashiest part of game development, but these small quality-of-life things matter a lot, and it really helps to tie everything together.

I’m also wrapping up the ability to save your progress, which is a pretty big milestone for how the game plays and feels. I’ll be adding some screenshots of the updated game menu in this post, and I plan on sharing new gameplay images in the next few weeks as more pieces come together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088123/65fc2625874aaf3fcf954b39a718047d26326298.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088123/a128d7b802af7c25caf5de8b47a9ab2ac563bd46.png[/img]

[b]Improved trailer [/b]

A lot has changed visually and mechanically since last year, so I’ll also be working on a new trailer soon that better reflects the direction Serial Victims is heading in. The current one’s feeling pretty outdated at this point.

On a fun note: the Steam wishlists have been steadily going up, which is really encouraging to see. To celebrate that a bit, I’ll be making a small video for the [url=https://www.youtube.com/@BlueColumnGame]YouTube channel[/url] that ties into that somewhere in June.

[b]Localization (Maybe?)[/b]

I’ve also started looking into localization options, which would allow the game to eventually be played in multiple languages. It has been requested by multiple people so I will try and implement that. That said, it’ll most likely launch in English only at first, but the groundwork is being laid so more languages can be added down the line.

That’s about it for now. Thanks again to everyone who’s wishlisted the game or followed along quietly. Your support really does make a difference, especially since this will be my first commercial release.

Next devlog will go into a specific feature again, most likely the implemented audio system that allows you to interact with the killers.

Until next time,
– Thijs

notes.title: Welcome to the 'Serial Victims' Steam Page!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Welcome to the official Steam page for [b]Serial Victims[/b]!

I am thrilled to have you here and excited to share this journey with you. Serial Victims is my first commercial release, and I can't wait for you to experience it when it launches early next year. 🚀

As I continue to develop and refine the game, your support and feedback will be invaluable. Here are a few ways you can stay connected and contribute:

[list]
[*] [b]Wishlist the Game:[/b] Adding Serial Victims to your wishlist will not only help you stay updated with all the latest news and updates, but it also greatly supports me in getting the game in front of more players. 

[*] [b]Follow on Social Media:[/b] Stay in the loop by following [b]'Blue Column Games'[/b] on all social media channels. I’ll be posting regular updates, sneak peeks, and other content. Plus, it’s a great way to engage with what can hopefully become a great community.
 
[*] [b]Share Your Feedback and Ideas:[/b] I am committed to making Serial Victims the best it can be, and I believe that your input can make a big difference. Feel free to leave comments, start discussions, and share your ideas with me. Your feedback is essential, and I am always eager to hear from my community.
[/list]

Expect regular updates from me, detailing progress, showcasing new features, and perhaps a few surprises along the way. I'm passionate about this project and would genuinely appreciate your support and shared enthusiasm.

Thank you for joining me on this adventure!

Best regards,

Thijs / Blue Column Games

P.S. Don't forget to hit that subscribe... I mean wishlist button! 👍
